tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Default background for every page, section and side area. Use it everywhere a site would normally be white. Not part of the logo.

tokens.name: sand-deep
tokens.usage: Second surface on top of sand: cards, form panels, alternating sections, dividers.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour, matching the logo background. Primary buttons, header and footer bands, links on sand (6.3:1).

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Colour of the TropiFix wordmark. Headings on sand (7.1:1), and hover state for teal.

tokens.name: teal-tint
tokens.usage: Soft teal fill for selected chips, info notes and zone tags. Use teal or ink text on it.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Accent colour, matching the logo's tools. Fills only: the main request button, highlights, small graphic marks. Never text on sand (2.5:1). Use ink text on coral (4.7:1).

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral for text and links on sand only (4.9:1). Too low on sand-deep, so use teal there.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on sand, sand-deep and teal-tint (12:1 on sand). Also the text colour on coral buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and form field borders on sand (5.7:1) and sand-deep (5.0:1).

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on teal and teal-deep only (7.1:1). Never use as a background: sand replaces white.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label, and between tightly related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and button padding, and the side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between blocks within a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between page sections. Use 96px (2 × space-12) on desktop heroes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, photos and panels. Echoes the rounded ends of the logo's tools.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, plus the WhatsApp and request call-to-action.
